name: FluxCap
long_description: FluxCap is a Deep Legal Tech platform built to think like a lawyer, bringing expert-level legal reasoning to complex litigation and helping ambitious lawyers win cases on the merits, not resources. Its platform, powered by its Advanced Legal Reasoning Architecture (ALRA), helps lawyers reason through the law, evidence, and strategy of a case as a whole. FluxCap was founded by Jonathan Kanter, former U.S. Assistant Attorney General for Antitrust, and Doha Mekki, former Acting Assistant Attorney General, and built by former Justice Department lawyers and Palantir engineers working side by side. The company is backed by YCombinator, with participation from Bloomberg Beta, Deep Work Capital, Coalition Operators, and Omidyar Network. FluxCap built its litigation platform to start with Antitrust and will soon expand into other sectors. FluxCap is currently being used to support live, complex cases.
one_liner: FluxCap is Deep Legal Tech built to think like a lawyer
